scope: Fresh reduced-pipeline comparisons. Existing owned JSON moves, buffered preparation output, streamed report JSON and single-pass HTML escaping retained. Whole-command elapsed, wait4 CPU and exact peak RSS are separate from profiling and all post-run acceptance checks. No savings from older paths are added.

builds.serial: Existing final-evidence/after executable; source hashes verified against current unchanged implementation.
builds.profile: Disposable checkout with profiling.patch plus src/profiling.rs and examples; never used for whole-command timings.

metadata.method: Three alternating paired rounds unless specified; exclusive benchmark lock. Warm filesystem caches. No profiler. wait4 CPU and peak RSS. Hash/content comparisons excluded from command time.

report_replay.limitations: Synthetic report-state replay only; not notice generation or a 10000-notice command. Adaptive replay uses doubling row counts without the wall-clock cap or setup writes. Compact mode removes message and measurements recursively only from passing checks; not adopted.

styled_qr.independent_decoder: ZXing-C++ via PyMuPDF PDF rasterization at 216dpi

artifact_retention.reason: Disk capacity; cleanup only during verification with the benchmark coordinator stopped and no timed child alive. All hashes and complete records had already passed checks.
artifact_retention.fully_retained: First paired round of each timing experiment. All timing runs retain saved JSON and HTML; other generated files were removed only after verification, outside timing.
artifact_retention.cleanup_5000: After all six timed runs and all 15,050 hashes per run passed verification, under the exclusive benchmark lock.
